name: {{title}}
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lua5.1 && git clone --depth 1 "{{repo}}" "$HOME/polestar" && cd "$HOME/polestar" && npm link && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p forge && sudo ln -sf "$HOME/polestar/rust/target/release/forge" /usr/local/bin/forge && forge data build --no-web-xp --no-web-zones
